Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: Let's try that again, shall we?
Ahem. Question the first!
What is your favorite color? You told it to me, and I've kept it secret all this time.
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: Jaká je tvá nejoblíbenější barva? Prozradil jsi mi ji a já ji celou tu dobu střežil jako tajemství.

Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: Ruby red.
Emerald green.
Ocean blue.
Coral pink.
Black, like the depths of my soul.
What kind of ridiculous question is this?
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: Co je tohle za směšnou otázku?

Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: Oooh, <Lore>correct</Lore>!
Question the second! What do you fear?
The deep, dark depths of the sea.
Creepy crawly things.
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: Všeho, co leze a nahání hrůzu.

Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: Losing my friends.
Nothing.
<Lore>Correct again!</Lore>
Only one question remains. Who do you trust the most?
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: Zbývá už jen jedna otázka. Komu věříš nejvíc?

Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: Milo Thatch.
Jack Sparrow.
Megara.
Wendy Darling.
Captain Hook.
Ah... incorrect! That was the right answer once.
But the very last time we spoke, you asked me to change it. I was quite confused.
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: Ale když jsme spolu mluvili naposledy, požádal jsi mě, abych ji změnil. Byl jsem z toho docela zmatený.

Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: I'm afraid that I can't allow you to pass. Not until you get each question right. Try again!
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: Obávám se, že tě nemohu nechat projít. Ne dokud neodpovíš na každou otázku správně. Zkus to znovu!

Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: Yes. <Lore>Correct.</Lore> The very last time we spoke, you asked me to change this answer to Captain Hook.
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: Ano. <Lore>Správně.</Lore> Když jsme spolu mluvili naposledy, požádal jsi mě, abych tuto odpověď změnil na: Kapitán Hook.

Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: I'm opening the way for you to pass.
If you really are the Legendary Adventurer, then it's your ridiculous question, not mine.
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: Pokud opravdu jsi Legendární dobrodruh, pak je to tvoje směšná otázka, ne moje.

Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: And if you want through this door, you'll answer it.
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: A jestli chceš projít těmito dveřmi, odpovíš na ni.

Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: Oh! Why, you've returned! You've returned at last!
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: Ó! Ty ses vrátil! Konečně ses vrátil!

Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: Wait a moment. Is this a trick?
You are the Legendary Adventurer, aren't you?
Of course I am!
It's what everyone tells me.
What gives you the right to question me, door?!
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: Co ti dává právo mě vyslýchat, ty dveře?!

Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: Ah, well, that's lucky.
I guard the way to a Sunken Echo. I was told to open only for the Legendary Adventurer.
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: Střežím cestu k Potopené ozvěně. Bylo mi řečeno, abych otevřel pouze Legendárnímu dobrodruhovi.

Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: I'm afraid that I can't just take your word for it, though. I must put you to the test.
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: Obávám se však, že ti nemůžu jen tak věřit. Musím tě podrobit zkoušce.

Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: Hmm, then I suppose it's likely to be true.
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: Hmm, pak to tedy bude nejspíš pravda.

Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.en: Why, it's my primary function!
Expansion04Main_DarkCastleDoor/DarkCastl.cz: Vždyť je to má hlavní funkce!
